_note: Source of truth for skillfile's render targets. Each target maps a tool to a `format` (which renderer produces the bytes) and a `dest` path template relative to the repo root. `{repo}` expands to the scanned repo name. Same `format` name guarantees byte-identical output, so two targets may share a format only if their generated files are identical. `default: true` targets are written by a bare `skillfile init`; the rest are opt-in via `--tools` and are then remembered in SKILLFILE.md frontmatter so bare `update`/`check` keep honouring them. `owns` is the top-level repo entry the target creates — every `owns` value is excluded from the scan fingerprint unconditionally (whether or not the target is enabled), so the freshness hash never depends on which tools a repo opted into. Targets that would write inside a directory skillfile does not own (e.g. .github/) are deliberately absent: those tools read AGENTS.md natively. scripts/check-tools.js (CI: ci.yml) fails the build if this file disagrees with the renderer registry in src/render.js. To add a target: add an entry here, add its `format` to RENDERERS in src/render.js if new, then run `npm run check-tools`.
